steam.rateLimited: Steam asked to wait a minute before the next refresh

kindReason.namedForTarget: Requires {{targets}} and is named after it
kindReason.patchNamed: Requires {{targets}} and is named like a patch
kindReason.scriptsContent: Adds item, recipe or vehicle scripts
kindReason.smallLuaOnly: A small mod with only Lua files

reason.require_after: Loads after {{other}} because it requires it
reason.requireVia_after: Loads after {{other}}: it requires {{via}}, which requires {{other}}
reason.requireVia_before: Loads before {{other}}, which requires it through {{via}}
reason.steamRequired_after: Loads after {{other}}: its Workshop page lists it as required
reason.steamRequired_before: Loads before {{other}}, whose Workshop page lists it as required
reason.patch_after: Loads after {{other}} because it patches it
reason.conflictWinner_after: Loads after {{other}} to keep winning their shared files
reason.conflictWinner_before: Loads before {{other}}, which wins their shared files
reason.keepTogether: Kept together with the rest of {{group}}
reason.tier2: Interface and other mods load in the middle
reason.displaced: Moved aside to make room for mods that had to move

problem.cycle: {{after}} should load after {{before}} ({{rule}}), but that would close a loop
problem.conflictsWithHarder: {{after}} should load after {{before}} ({{rule}}), but {{by}} says otherwise
problem.loop: {{mods}} go round in a loop; the order between {{before}} and {{after}} ({{rule}}) was dropped
problem.loopCrash: {{mods}} require each other in a loop: the server crashes loading them. Remove one of them.
problem.keepTogetherBroken: {{group}} cannot stay together: {{mods}} must load between its members
problem.inTwoGroups: {{mod}} is in two groups kept together ({{group}}, {{other}}); only the first keeps it
problem.winnerLoop: {{newWinner}} will win their shared files over {{previousWinner}}: keeping the old winner would close a loop
problem.winnerChanged: {{newWinner}} will win their shared files over {{previousWinner}}, because of {{by}}
problem.implicit_one: The game loads {{mod}} first anyway: {{requiredBy}} requires it, but it is not in your list
problem.implicit_other: The game loads {{mod}} first anyway: {{requiredBy}} require it, but it is not in your list

sort.calmDesc: Every rule the panel knows is met: nothing needs to move.
sort.applyHint: Apply changes the list below; Save Order writes it.
sort.tiered: Libraries first, patches and translations last
sort.tieredHint: Also orders by kind. Off: only what a rule asks for moves.
sort.failedFallback: The load order could not be planned. Try again.

why.title: Why is {{mod}} here?
why.wouldMove: Smart sort would move it to #{{to}}
why.reasonsPlanned: Why it loads here, once sorted
why.unavailable: No explanation right now. Try again in a moment.
why.noReasons: Nothing ties it to a place: it stays where you put it.
why.buttonAriaMoves: Why is {{mod}} here? Smart sort would move it
why.buttonTitleMoves: Smart sort would move it. Why?
